from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
pairs = [('data/d4d_concatenated/claudecode_agent/2026-09-17_claude-opus-5-agentic-generalized-v10y-chorus_rep1/CHORUS_d4d.yaml', 'data/d4d_concatenated/claudecode_agent_core/2026-09-17_claude-opus-5-agentic-generalized-v10y-chorus_rep1/evidence/original_full.yaml'), ('data/d4d_concatenated/claudecode_agent_core/2026-09-17_claude-opus-5-agentic-generalized-v10y-chorus_rep1/CHORUS_d4d_core.yaml', 'data/d4d_concatenated/claudecode_agent_core/2026-09-17_claude-opus-5-agentic-generalized-v10y-chorus_rep1/evidence/original_core.yaml')]
pins = {}
for src, dst in pairs:
    raw = Path(src).read_bytes()
    Path(dst).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with Path(dst).open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
    pins[dst] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({'original_sha256': pins}, sort_keys=True))
